projection.growthBasis: Year-over-year growth from basedOnYear (2025) to currentYear (2026) reflects raised FY26 capex guidance announced during Q1 2026 hyperscaler earnings season. Aggregate Big-5 capex (Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon, Oracle) of approximately USD 725 billion for 2026, the vast majority directed at AI compute, data centers, and networking. Sources: Bloomberg Intelligence, CreditSights, and Statista 2026-Q1 estimates. Historical entries reflect aggregate Big-5 hyperscaler capital expenditure as reported in 10-K filings, rounded to the nearest USD 5 billion.

source: Q1 2026 hyperscaler earnings — Bloomberg Intelligence, CreditSights, Statista compilation

categories.methodology: Aggregate US telecom-equipment capital investment 1996-2001 — approximately USD 500 billion in nominal dollars, financed largely with debt. The buildout that preceded the 2001 telecom bust.

sources.name: Bloomberg Intelligence — Generative AI to become a $1.3 trillion market by 2032

categories.methodology: Estimated 2025 global generative-AI software and services revenue (approximately USD 50 billion), per Bloomberg Intelligence's market sizing. Capex-to-revenue ratio is one of the most cited single bubble indicators.

sources.name: The Planetary Society — How much did the Apollo program cost?

categories.methodology: Total cumulative cost of the Apollo program (1961-1973), inflation-adjusted to 2024 USD: approximately USD 280 billion. Covers Mercury and Gemini predecessor programs, the Saturn V launch system, and all Apollo missions through Apollo 17.

sources.name: Brookings Institution — The Costs of the Manhattan Project (Atomic Audit, Stephen I. Schwartz)

categories.methodology: Total cost of the Manhattan Project (1942-1946), USD 1.9 billion nominal, inflation-adjusted to approximately USD 30 billion in 2024 USD per Brookings' Atomic Audit (Schwartz, 1998).

sources.name: Nature Food / IFPRI — Investment needs to end hunger by 2030

categories.methodology: Average additional annual public expenditure (approximately USD 33 billion) required from donors and low/middle-income governments through 2030 to end hunger (SDG 2), per Ceres2030 / IFPRI models published in Nature Food.

sources.name: World Bank — The Costs of Meeting the 2030 SDG Targets on Drinking Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene

categories.methodology: Annual capital investment of approximately USD 114 billion needed through 2030 to achieve universal safely managed drinking water, per the World Bank's SDG 6 costing study (Hutton & Varughese 2016).

sources.name: The Lancet Commission on Malaria Eradication

categories.methodology: Total cumulative additional global investment required to eradicate malaria by 2030 (approximately USD 90-120 billion), per the Lancet Commission's modelled additional funding on top of current spending.

Estimated annual capital investment required to modernise the US power grid (transmission upgrades, distribution hardening, interconnection-queue clearing) — approximately USD 167 billion per year over 30 years toward a net-zero-aligned grid, per Princeton REPEAT and DOE Grid Deployment Office estimates.
